profile.headline: Lead Software Developer at State Farm ®
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Java, Android, Data Structures, RDBMS, MySQL and Amazon Web Services (AWS). Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from San Jose State University.

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Worked at Apple Inc. as Technical Support Engineer on Apple Online Store team. 

Responsible for diagnosing, replicating, performing root cause analysis, and providing feedback for software issues reported within SLA time frame.

Responsible for implementing code fix of software bugs and making software enhancements as required.

Coordinate with various teams as necessary to resolve application issues. Clearly documented cases with troubleshooting steps, recommendations, and resolutions.

Participate in monthly team meetings and daily scrum meetings, and provide input on backlog issues, technical process, and new processes within the team.

Trained with senior engineers to enhance my personal technical skills as a Technical Support Engineer and learned internal process for escalating issues and approving or denying handovers to specific teams.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer in TCS’s innovative Digital Reimagination Studio; my primary role was to develop and demo new prototypes. 

Truck Cargo Monitoring - Developed a prototype that monitors the temperature and humidity of truck cargo carrying goods. Used Amazon Web Services (AWS) such as Kinesis, Lambda, SNS, and DynamoDB. Created Android application and Amazon Alexa skill for Amazon Echo to enable voice-actuated access to cargo status

KokoVoice Application - Developed an Android application prototype that authenticates user’s voice to display user’s profile on a TV application via Bluetooth. Used Alexa Voice Library to enable voice-actuated access to the Amazon Alexa service. Used Microsoft Azure’s speech recognition API to authenticate user’s voice.

Ether Wallet  - Developed a blockchain application on Ethereum platform that sends and receives ethers (crypto currency) among users over a private network.  Created smart contracts using solidity and an Android application for users to manage their accounts. Created a guide to help other developers understand ethereum blockchain platform

positions.title: Front Counter Assistant
positions.description: Helped students checking in and out for computers in the lab. Maintained an organized and professional work environment. Assisted media technician by working on media resources, and entering data in the database.
